newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rugby league-Cronulla upset Brisbane Broncos.
newsitem.headline: Rugby league-Cronulla upset Brisbane Broncos.

text.p: Cronulla Sharks, chasing their first Australian Rugby League premiership title, upset Brisbane Broncos 22-16 on Saturday to move within one match of reaching this season's grand final.
Cronulla will face Manly next Sunday for a place in the grand final on September 29 after the Sharks and Brisbane shared six tries at the Sydney Football Stadium.
Five goals from the boot of Cronulla winger Mat Rogers ultimately proved the difference between the two sides.
Australia test centre Andrew Ettingshausen, fullback David Peachey and winger Richard Barnett scored tries for Cronulla.

The Sharks, who entered the league in 1967 and qualified for this year's playoffs from a position below Brisbane in the standings at the end of the regular season, were losing grand finalists in 1973 and 1978.
Sydney City will face St George in another playoff on Sunday, with the winner advancing to meet North Sydney in a semifinal next weekend.
